rationale: Record a Pulp-owned correction to a coordinate query inside the watched view surface. ViewInspector::absolute_bounds walked the parent chain summing bounds() alone, so any descendant of a scrolled container reported its unscrolled position and every appearance, overlap and clipping detector built on it judged only the first viewport-worth of a long panel. This adds View::child_paint_offset(const View& child), the translation a container applies to ONE child's paint, and accumulates it in that walk. The primitive takes the child because the answer is not uniform: ScrollView::paint_all draws an ordinary child under translate(-scroll_x, -scroll_y) but a Position::sticky child under translate(-scroll_x, 0) so it stays pinned, and ScrollView's override returns each of those in turn. applies_child_paint_offset() keeps its existing ScrollView override and its existing semantics: it is a whole-container predicate feeding repaint escalation, deliberately not derived from any single child's offset, because over-reporting true only widens a repaint whereas a per-child derivation would miss a container that moves some children and not others. The change corrects what a bounds query reports; it does not change what is painted, adds no rendering or backend path, no new event source, and no production paint behavior. This changes no design ingest, no captured output, no rendering, layout or packaging behavior, no accepted expansion boundary, and no Vellum source authority.
